observations: E2 explicitly creates a search dataset containing the first 80% of the frozen bars.
Generation validation occupies the 60%-80% segment and is available to generation scoring.
The final 20% is absent from the search dataset.
The sealed-holdout evaluator reconstructs the immutable campaign dataset and evaluates the final 20% using validation_split=0.8.
The source boundary supports an explicit separation between generation search/validation and the final sealed holdout.
This audit verifies the data-boundary implementation; it does not establish that every possible external dependency or future code path is incapable of leaking holdout information.
